Mental Health Care Plan Details

Principal Problem:
- Patient Goal(s):
  - Alleviate acute headache symptoms; determine whether tension-type or migraine; reduce work-related stress; resume normal functioning; improve sleep and hydration
- Clinical Goal(s):
  - Headache relief with first-line NSAID (Ibuprofen); continue Paracetamol as needed
  - Reduce work-related stress; consider one week off work
  - Initiate counselling referral; sleep 7–8 hours/night; hydration 1.5–2 L/day
  - Follow-up in 1 week; consider blood tests if not improving
- Actions (Patient):
  - Take Ibuprofen as advised (dose/route/frequency not documented)
  - Continue Paracetamol as needed
  - Take a week off work (self-certify)
  - Initiate counselling referral via provided link
  - Ensure 7–8 hours sleep per night and 1.5–2 L fluids per day
  - Contact clinic if symptoms worsen or red flags develop
- Actions (Clinician/GP):
  - Advise Ibuprofen as first-line for likely migraine/tension headache; provide dosing guidance
  - Provide counselling referral link and support self-referral
  - Recommend short-term work leave and safety netting
  - Provide information about headache danger signs
  - Schedule follow-up in 1 week
  - Consider blood tests if symptoms persist or worsen

Secondary Problem (if applicable):
- Patient Goal(s):
  - Manage workplace anxiety; maintain mood stability
- Clinical Goal(s):
  - Reduce situational anxiety; monitor Sertraline; maintain coping
- Actions (Patient):
  - Continue Sertraline (dose not documented)
  - Attend counselling; implement sleep/hydration recommendations
  - Monitor headaches and anxiety
- Actions (Clinician/GP):
  - Monitor Sertraline therapy; discuss plan if needed
  - Facilitate counselling referral; arrange follow-up
  - Reassess at follow-up; consider tests if not improving
